skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts about hardware, drawing algorithms, and fundamental applications in computer graphics.
Apply basic graphic objects in 2D and 3D space, including point, line, curve, and surface transformations.
Master 2D and 3D transformation techniques such as translation, scaling, rotation, and matrix representation.
Understand properties of affine transformations and apply them to specific examples.
Learn and apply clipping algorithms like Cohen-Sutherland and Liang-Barsky for line and polygon clipping.
Understand the process of displaying 3D graphics objects, including coordinate systems and projection methods.
Transform between world coordinates and device coordinates using various projection techniques.
Use OpenGL library for programming and applying graphics algorithms.
Apply problem-solving skills to solve graphic-related problems individually and in groups.
Work collaboratively with peers to complete group assignments and presentations.
Develop the ability to learn independently and seek out relevant materials to complete assignments.
